ownership: Oklahoma Secretary of State Business Entities Bulk Orders
allowed_use: offline structural validation of an operator-supplied exact package
prohibited_use: automated acquisition, purchase, account creation, or portal operation
natural-person, agent, officer, contact, tax identifier, telephone, audit comment, document, or free-text retention
physical-site, current-operation, statewide-completeness, national-admission, or production-pointer claims
attribution: Source: Oklahoma Secretary of State Business Entities Bulk Orders; retain package checksum, observation date, source process date, and layout limitations.
retention: Operator-supplied input and privacy-minimized projection remain internal and local-review-only pending explicit source-rights approval.
redistribution: Record-level redistribution is not authorized by this policy. Public-record availability is not treated as a redistribution grant. The official https://www.sos.ok.gov/feedback/disclaimer.aspx reviewed 2026-10-03 describes public filing data, personal-information redactions and accuracy/timeliness limitations; it is not an express commercial bulk redistribution license.
